title: Static Single-Hump Swept-Neck Camel
description: One newly authored whole stylised single-hump camel-like animal in a fixed grounded pose. A deep torso rises into one broad-based high dorsal hump in the very same continuous skin. Its front neck root sweeps low and forwards before curving upwards into a small elongated blunt head, rather than a straight stretched giraffe neck. Four long joint-shaped legs end in broad thick two-lobed pad feet with shallow front clefts; two small thick ears, low lateral eyes and a hanging tapered tufted tail complete the whole. All body sections, curved neck/head and appendage outlines are newly authored, not old deer or giraffe arrays with antlers removed or hump decoration attached. One animal prop, zero scenes; no saddle or rider. Static artistic exterior only, no exact species/anatomy, riding, load capacity, gait, animal handling or biological claim.
